Page 9 IN THE HOLY NAME OF JESUS LET US BEGIN THE YEAR 1912 The old year closed with a dreary day - rain, snow and fog - as though mourning at prospects it had to leave for the new year, of trouble and promises of war on all sides and directions.
Jan. 1st Joseph Horsfall died, baptized and anointed at 5:30 AM aged 90 years and 3 months Today
2nd Buried Martin Kennedy - six. Altar boys pall - bearers- B. Landy, L. Schaefer, F. McCready and Alb. Ahearn. G. Gorman and C. O Hara. John Campbell and some other boys were to go with Fr. Sol. (who went with -) but the extra carriag had a mishap and the automobile that came in its place was late. Funeral was largely attended May He Rest In Peace!
Same day, Jan. 2nd Albert Ahearn applied for ad- mission as a student from the graduating class of parish school and altar boys Soc.
Jan. 3rd Parish School reopened.
4 th Students returned and Albert Ahearn left parish-school to become a student in the monastery.
6 Epiphany Prizes and presents given to Altar boys. First prize 1 B. Landy (served 560 times) gold medal 2 G. Gorman 522 silver 3 Fr. Mc Cready 507 Pearl knife. Other prizes were given to A. Dempsey, C. O Hara, A. Ahearn, D. McCarthy, Jms Smith, Patrick Laughlin, J. Dempsey and others.
9th Martin Kennedy's Mass. High Mass as 7th from funeral, for Martin Kennedy - requested by the Altar boys. The Mass was at 7 oclock and many went to Holy Communion, i. e. considering the very stormy and slushy morning- 13 Holy Communions. R.I. Pace!
